# Final talk production set

This child document is rendered from `causal_verbs.Rmd` after all validated
summaries and models exist. It changes presentation only: it reuses the original
plot objects, summary rows, fitted predictions and confidence limits. Source
exports remain in their original folders. The final folder's README carries
sample, pilot, transformation and interpretation notes removed from the slides.

```{r final-talk-helpers}
final_root = "../../figures/talk_final"
final_sections = c("chain_baseline", "baseline_intention", "single_cause")
for (section in final_sections) for (kind in c("main", "builds", "backup"))
  dir.create(file.path(final_root, section, kind), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
final_make_builds = getOption("causal_verbs.final_builds", TRUE)
final_registry = list()
final_build_registry = list()
final_plots = list()
final_geometry_checks = list()
final_font = "sans"

final_theme = function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 32, base_family = final_font) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 32, color = "#242424"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 36),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 16)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 18)),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "#777777", linewidth = .65),
          axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#777777", linewidth = .65),
          panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.8, "cm"),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 36, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 18)),
          legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 30), legend.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
          legend.key.width = grid::unit(2, "cm"), legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(.6, "cm"), legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(.6, "cm"),
          legend.margin = margin(t = 10), plot.margin = margin(20, 32, 18, 24))
}

final_matched_theme = function() {
  final_theme() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 40), axis.title = element_text(size = 44),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 44, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 20)),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 34), legend.key.width = grid::unit(2.2, "cm"))
}

# Clone each drawing layer before editing it, so source plots remain untouched.
# Ribbon predictions are already saved; use every tenth grid row, including ends.
final_polish = function(plot, scatter = FALSE) {
  plot$layers = lapply(plot$layers, function(source_layer) {
    layer = ggproto(NULL, source_layer)
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomErrorbar")) {
      layer$geom = GeomLinerange
      layer$geom_params$width = NULL
      layer$aes_params$width = NULL
    }
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomRibbon")) {
      layer$geom = GeomLinerange
      groups = intersect(c("study", "panel", "intention"), names(layer$data))
      layer$data = layer$data %>% group_by(across(all_of(groups))) %>%
        filter(row_number() %in% unique(c(seq(1L, n(), by = 10L), n()))) %>% ungroup()
      layer$mapping$colour = layer$mapping$fill
      layer$mapping$fill = NULL
    }
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomLinerange")) {
      layer$aes_params$linewidth = .65
      layer$aes_params$linetype = "solid"
      if (is.null(layer$mapping$alpha)) layer$aes_params$alpha = .65 else {
        rows = if (is.data.frame(layer$data)) layer$data else plot$data
        rows$.final_ci_alpha = .65 * as.numeric(rlang::eval_tidy(layer$mapping$alpha, rows) > 0)
        layer$data = rows
        layer$mapping$alpha = rlang::quo(.final_ci_alpha)
        layer$aes_params$alpha = NULL
      }
    }
    if (inherits(layer$geom, c("GeomLine", "GeomSegment", "GeomSmooth")))
      layer$aes_params$linewidth = 2.4
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomPoint") && !scatter) {
      layer$aes_params$size = 8
      layer$aes_params$stroke = 1.4
    }
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomHline") && identical(layer$aes_params$linetype, "dashed"))
      layer$aes_params$linewidth = 1.1
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomRect")) layer$aes_params$fill = "#F3F3F3"
    layer
  })
  plot + final_theme() + labs(title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL, tag = NULL)
}

# Opacity reveals keep every row, legend, scale and facet in place.
final_reveal = function(plot, visible) {
  plot$layers = lapply(plot$layers, function(source_layer) {
    layer = ggproto(NULL, source_layer)
    if (inherits(layer$geom, c("GeomPoint", "GeomLine", "GeomSegment", "GeomLinerange"))) {
      rows = if (is.data.frame(layer$data)) layer$data else plot$data
      rows$.final_alpha = as.numeric(visible(rows)) * (if (is.null(layer$aes_params$alpha)) 1 else layer$aes_params$alpha)
      layer$data = rows
      layer$mapping$alpha = rlang::quo(.final_alpha)
      layer$aes_params$alpha = NULL
    }
    layer
  })
  plot + scale_alpha_identity(guide = "none") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
}

final_export = function(plot, destination, width, height) {
  # Scientific figures use vector PDF and 240-dpi PNG from the same ggplot object.
  ggsave(paste0(destination, ".pdf"), plot, width = width, height = height,
         device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
  ggsave(paste0(destination, ".png"), plot, width = width, height = height,
         device = ragg::agg_png, dpi = 240, bg = "white")
}
final_family = function(stem, section, source, plot, width, height, values,
                         build_names = NULL, build_function = NULL, order = NA_integer_,
                         note = "", kind = "main") {
  path = file.path(section, kind, stem)
  destination = file.path(final_root, path)
  final_export(plot, destination, width, height)
  write_csv(values, paste0(destination, "_values.csv"))
  final_plots[[stem]] <<- plot
  final_registry[[stem]] <<- tibble(order, stem, section, kind, final = paste0(path, ".pdf"),
    source, builds = if (is.null(build_names)) "" else file.path(section, "builds", stem), note)
  if (!is.null(build_names) && final_make_builds) {
    build_dir = file.path(final_root, section, "builds", stem)
    dir.create(build_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    reference = ggplot_build(plot)
    reference_grob = ggplotGrob(plot)
    for (j in seq_along(build_names)) {
      build_plot = build_function(j - 1L)
      built = ggplot_build(build_plot)
      grob = ggplotGrob(build_plot)
      stopifnot(identical(built$layout$layout, reference$layout$layout),
                identical(grob$layout, reference_grob$layout),
                isTRUE(all.equal(grid::convertWidth(grob$widths, "cm", valueOnly = TRUE),
                                 grid::convertWidth(reference_grob$widths, "cm", valueOnly = TRUE))),
                isTRUE(all.equal(grid::convertHeight(grob$heights, "cm", valueOnly = TRUE),
                                 grid::convertHeight(reference_grob$heights, "cm", valueOnly = TRUE))))
      for (panel in seq_along(reference$layout$panel_params))
        stopifnot(identical(built$layout$panel_params[[panel]]$x.range, reference$layout$panel_params[[panel]]$x.range),
                  identical(built$layout$panel_params[[panel]]$y.range, reference$layout$panel_params[[panel]]$y.range))
      build_destination = file.path(build_dir, build_names[j])
      if (j == length(build_names)) {
        stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(built$data, reference$data)))
        # The full build is byte-identical to the main PDF and PNG.
        for (extension in c(".pdf", ".png"))
          stopifnot(file.copy(paste0(destination, extension), paste0(build_destination, extension), overwrite = TRUE))
      } else final_export(build_plot, build_destination, width, height)
      final_build_registry[[length(final_build_registry) + 1L]] <<- tibble(
        figure = stem, build = j - 1L, filename = file.path(section, "builds", stem, build_names[j]),
        full = j == length(build_names), fixed_geometry = TRUE)
    }
    final_geometry_checks[[stem]] <<- TRUE
  }
}
```

## Included-participant counts for raw figures

Counts come from final included child records and included adult participant
means, deduplicated before counting. Role and measure never inflate the display
N. The point values retain their own effective denominator alongside display N.

```{r final-talk-counts}
final_sample_counts = function(children, adults, study) {
  bind_rows(
    children %>% transmute(population = "Children", participant,
                            age_group = as.character(age), condition = as.character(condition)),
    adults %>% transmute(population = "Adults", participant,
                          age_group = "Adult", condition = as.character(condition))) %>%
    distinct(population, participant, age_group, condition) %>%
    count(population, age_group, condition, name = "display_n") %>%
    mutate(study = study, age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_labels)) %>%
    arrange(age_group, match(condition, c("Baseline", "Intentional", "Accidental")))
}
final_ns = bind_rows(
  final_sample_counts(df.study1.children.included, df.study1.adults.means, "Study 1"),
  final_sample_counts(df.study2.children.included, df.study2.adults.means, "Study 2"),
  final_sample_counts(df.single.included, df.single.adults.means, "Single Cause"))
stopifnot(sum(filter(final_ns, study == "Study 1")$display_n) == nrow(df.study1.role.scores),
          sum(filter(final_ns, study == "Study 2", population == "Children")$display_n) == nrow(df.study2.children.included),
          sum(filter(final_ns, study == "Single Cause", population == "Children")$display_n) == nrow(df.single.included))
write_csv(final_ns, file.path(final_root, "raw_figure_sample_sizes.csv"))
final_raw_values = function(summary, study_name) {
  summary %>% mutate(study = study_name) %>%
    left_join(final_ns, by = c("study", "population", "age_group", "condition"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    mutate(point_missing_n = display_n - n)
}
final_s1_values = final_raw_values(df.study1.summary, "Study 1")
final_s2_values = final_raw_values(df.study2.summary, "Study 2")
final_sc_values = final_raw_values(df.single.summary, "Single Cause")
stopifnot(!anyNA(final_s1_values$display_n), !anyNA(final_s2_values$display_n), !anyNA(final_sc_values$display_n),
          all(bind_rows(final_s1_values, final_s2_values, final_sc_values)$point_missing_n >= 0))

final_raw = function(plot, study, measures = measure_order) {
  is_single = study == "Single Cause"
  split_condition = study != "Study 1"
  adult_x = if (is_single) 7.8 else 10.8
  last_child = if (is_single) 6 else 9
  # Change only presentation positions: all age series get the same adult gap.
  move_adult = function(rows) {
    if (!is.data.frame(rows) || !"population" %in% names(rows)) return(rows)
    old_adult = if (is_single) single_adult_position else 10
    rows %>% mutate(across(any_of(c("x", "plot_x")),
                          ~ .x + if_else(population == "Adults", adult_x - old_adult, 0)))
  }
  plot$data = move_adult(plot$data)
  plot$layers = lapply(plot$layers, function(source_layer) {
    layer = ggproto(NULL, source_layer); layer$data = move_adult(layer$data); layer
  })
  # Child shading replaces the old decorative grid/divider; quantitative marks stay unchanged.
  plot$layers = Filter(function(layer) !inherits(layer$geom, c("GeomHline", "GeomVline")), plot$layers)
  plot$layers = c(list(
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = last_child + .25, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#F3F3F3"),
    geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#777777", linewidth = 1.1)), plot$layers)
  plot = final_polish(plot)
  counts = filter(final_ns, .data$study == .env$study) %>%
    mutate(x = if_else(age_group == "Adult", adult_x, suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(age_group)))),
           y = if (split_condition) if_else(condition == "Intentional", -.15, -.25) else -.16,
           label = paste0("n=", display_n)) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(measure = factor(measures, levels = measures))
  plot = plot +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(3:last_child, adult_x), labels = c(as.character(3:last_child), "Adult"),
                       limits = c(2.6, adult_x + .55), expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, .25), labels = function(x) paste0(100 * x, "%"),
                       expand = expansion(add = .035)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
    geom_text(data = counts, aes(x = x + if (split_condition) .07 else 0, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, family = final_font, size = 8.2, color = "#333333", show.legend = FALSE) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = if (split_condition) 96 else 65)),
          panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(if (split_condition) 4.1 else 3.1, "cm"))
  if (split_condition) plot = plot +
    geom_point(data = filter(counts, condition == "Intentional"), aes(x = x - .32, y = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, fill = "#333333", color = "#333333", size = 3.4, stroke = .65) +
    geom_point(data = filter(counts, condition == "Accidental"), aes(x = x - .32, y = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 24, fill = "white", color = "#333333", size = 3.4, stroke = .65)
  plot
}
```

```{r final-talk-main-exports, results='hide'}
# Preserve the source sequence: blank; each condition's children; all adults.
final_matched = function(step) {
  plot = final_polish(plot_matched_role_development(step)) + final_matched_theme()
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) if (inherits(plot$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomSegment"))
    plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params$linewidth = 4
  plot
}
final_family("matched_role_differentiation_development_talk_v1", "baseline_intention",
  paste0(matched_role_output, "/matched_role_differentiation_development_talk_v1.pdf"),
  final_matched(4), 28, 11, df.matched.role.summary,
  c("build00_blank", "build01_baseline", "build02_add_accidental", "build03_add_intentional",
    "build04_add_adults_full"), final_matched, order = 4L,
  note = "Baseline | Accidental | Intentional; unchanged participant-score means and CIs. Adults appear in the final build.")

final_transition_order = c("Causal-role differentiation", "Single Cause", "Chain: Distal")
final_transition = function(step) final_reveal(final_polish(p.role.intention.v2),
  function(rows) match(as.character(rows$series), final_transition_order) <= step)
final_family("04_intention_effect_transition", "baseline_intention",
  paste0(age_adjusted_output, "/role_differentiation_intention_effects_talk_v2.pdf"),
  final_transition(3), 24, 11, df.role.intention.v2,

  final_transition, order = 5L, note = "Single Cause child data are pilot data, ages 3–6 only. Adult is separate.")

# The matched synthesis and both relationships share a wide talk canvas and
# larger typography. Relationship points are observations, not fitted means;
# keep them subordinate to the heavy fitted curves and thin vertical CIs.
final_relationship = function(study, step) {
  source = if (study == "Study 1") p.study1.age.adjusted else p.study2.age.adjusted
  plot = final_polish(source, scatter = TRUE) + final_matched_theme() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F3F3F3", color = NA),
          panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(4.2, "cm"),
          legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(20, 80, 18, 24))
  if (study == "Study 1") {
    source_scales = plot$scales
    plot$scales = ggproto(NULL, source_scales)
    plot$scales$scales = Filter(function(scale) !"fill" %in% scale$aesthetics, plot$scales$scales)
  }
  plot$layers = Filter(function(layer) !inherits(layer$geom, "GeomVline"), plot$layers)
  plot$layers = lapply(plot$layers, function(source_layer) {
    layer = ggproto(NULL, source_layer)
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomLine")) {
      layer$aes_params$linewidth = 4
      layer$show.legend = FALSE
    }
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomPoint")) {
      layer$aes_params$alpha = .07
      layer$aes_params$size = 3.5
      if (study == "Study 2") {
        layer$mapping$fill = aes(fill = intention)$fill
        layer$aes_params$stroke = .65
        layer$show.legend = TRUE
        # Draw the condition marker over its legend line, so the triangle stays open.
        source_geom = layer$geom
        layer$geom = ggproto(NULL, source_geom, draw_key = function(data, params, size) {
          grid::grobTree(draw_key_path(data, params, size), draw_key_point(data, params, size))
        })
      }
    }
    layer
  })
  plot = final_reveal(plot, function(rows) {
    if (study == "Study 1") match(as.character(rows$panel), c("Fault", "Punish")) <= step
    else match(as.character(rows$intention), c("Accidental", "Intentional")) <= step
  })
  if (study == "Study 2") plot = plot +
    scale_shape_manual(NULL, values = condition_shapes, limits = condition_order) +
    scale_fill_manual(NULL, values = c(Intentional = comparison_colors[["Intentional"]], Accidental = "white"),
                      limits = condition_order) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(
      alpha = 1, size = 7, stroke = 1.3, linewidth = 4,
      shape = unname(condition_shapes[condition_order]),
      linetype = unname(condition_lines[condition_order]),
      fill = c(comparison_colors[["Intentional"]], "white"))),
      shape = "none", fill = "none", linetype = "none")
  if (step == 2L) {
    # Styling must leave fitted values, observed points (including fixed jitter)
    # and every displayed confidence limit exactly where the source put them.
    original = ggplot_build(source); updated = ggplot_build(plot)
    get_layer = function(p, b, geom) {
      i = which(vapply(p$layers, function(layer) inherits(layer$geom, geom), logical(1)))
      stopifnot(length(i) == 1L)
      as_tibble(b$data[[i]])
    }
    for (geom in c("GeomPoint", "GeomLine")) {
      old = get_layer(source, original, geom)
      new = get_layer(plot, updated, geom)
      stopifnot(identical(select(old, PANEL, x, y), select(new, PANEL, x, y)))
    }
    original_ci = get_layer(source, original, "GeomRibbon")
    displayed_ci = get_layer(plot, updated, "GeomLinerange")
    stopifnot(nrow(anti_join(select(displayed_ci, PANEL, x, ymin, ymax),
                            select(original_ci, PANEL, x, ymin, ymax),
                            by = c("PANEL", "x", "ymin", "ymax"))) == 0L,
              all(displayed_ci$linetype == "solid"))
  }
  plot
}
final_family("05_study1_age_adjusted_relationship", "chain_baseline",
  paste0(age_adjusted_output, "/study1_role_differentiation_age_adjusted_talk_v1.pdf"),
  final_relationship("Study 1", 2), 28, 11, filter(df.age.adjusted.predictions, study == "Study 1"),
  c("build00_blank", "build01_fault", "build02_add_punish_full"),
  function(step) final_relationship("Study 1", step), order = 6L,
  note = "Children only; original numeric-age-adjusted model and pointwise bootstrap prediction limits.")
final_family("06_study2_age_adjusted_relationship", "baseline_intention",
  paste0(age_adjusted_output, "/study2_role_differentiation_age_adjusted_talk_v1.pdf"),
  final_relationship("Study 2", 2), 28, 11, filter(df.age.adjusted.predictions, study == "Study 2"),
  c("build00_blank", "build01_accidental", "build02_add_intentional_full"),

  note = "Children only; original differentiation × intention + numeric age model. Unchanged predictions.")

final_sc_measures = c("Lexical", "Fault", "Punish")
final_sc_summary = df.single.summary %>% filter(measure %in% final_sc_measures) %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = final_sc_measures),

    "build04_fault_accidental", "build05_punish_intentional", "build06_punish_accidental_full"),
  final_sc, order = 8L, note = "Single Cause children are pilot data (ages 3–6); all 32 available adult records retained.")

  note = "Source centered figure plus its build11_add_chain_distal_gap_fill_full. Blue/red gap fills alpha=.18; these are not CIs.")
```

## Selected backups

These preserve the source estimates and the source distinction between a talk
version without CIs and an explicit CI backup. The context-sensitivity backup
uses its existing CI version.

```{r final-talk-backup-exports, results='hide'}
final_family("single_cause_four_measures_backup", "single_cause",
  paste0(single_output, "/single_cause_yes_responses_full.pdf"),
  final_raw(p.single.full, "Single Cause"), 24, 19, final_sc_values, kind = "backup",
  note = "Full raw-response backup including Caused. Single Cause children are pilot data.")
final_family("single_cause_vs_chain_distal_intention_effect_backup", "single_cause",
  paste0(binned_responsibility_output, "/single_cause_vs_chain_distal_intention_effect_talk_v1.pdf"),
  final_polish(p.binned.intention.effects), 24, 11, df.binned.intention.effects, kind = "backup",
  note = "Intentional minus Accidental; Single Cause children are pilot data; pointwise CIs are not context-difference tests.")
```

```{r final-talk-validation-and-index, results='asis'}
final_index = bind_rows(final_registry) %>% arrange(kind != "main", order, section, stem)
# Registry source links are relative to this final folder, not the R working directory.
final_index$source = sub("^../../figures/", "../", final_index$source)
write_csv(final_index, file.path(final_root, "figure_index.csv"))
if (final_make_builds) write_csv(bind_rows(final_build_registry), file.path(final_root, "build_manifest.csv"))
stopifnot(nrow(final_index) == 15L, identical(filter(final_index, kind == "main")$order, 1:9))
for (plot in final_plots) {
  stopifnot(is.null(plot$labels$title), is.null(plot$labels$subtitle), is.null(plot$labels$caption))
  for (layer in plot$layers)
    stopifnot(!inherits(layer$geom, c("GeomRibbon", "GeomErrorbar")))
}
if (final_make_builds) stopifnot(nrow(bind_rows(final_build_registry)) == 64L,
                                length(final_geometry_checks) == 9L)
# No participant identifiers are exported into the presentation folder.
for (entry in final_registry) {
  values = read_csv(file.path(final_root, sub("\\.pdf$", "_values.csv", entry$final)), show_col_types = FALSE)
  stopifnot(!any(names(values) %in% c("participant", "workerid", "response_uuid", "response_id")))
}

# Re-export existing model results as exact-value companions, without refitting.

write_csv(df.age.adjusted.contrasts, file.path(final_root, "age_adjusted_contrasts_unchanged.csv"))
```
